about: Leduc County is a municipal district in central Alberta surrounding the separate City of Leduc, Edmonton International Airport, and the Nisku industrial park—not the City of Leduc itself. Hamlets, farms, and energy-service acreages share the landscape south of Edmonton. Highways 2, 19, and 625 cross the county. About 14,000 people live in Leduc County.
